answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. A tundra of per-task receipts records who did what, and the walnut of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the whisper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
